newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keihin shares up on strong earnings.
newsitem.headline: Keihin shares up on strong earnings.

text.p: Shares of Keihin Seiki Manufacturing Co Ltd jumped on Wednesday afternoon, helped by its announcement of strong annual earnings, traders said.
At 0508 GMT, the share price of the carburetor maker affiliated with Honda Motor Co Ltd was up 160 yen at 1,400. It was the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Its turnover was 1.052 million shares at 0535 GMT.
Keihin Corp announced earlier that its group net profits for the year to March 31, 1997, jumped to 2.00 billion yen from 1.21 billion yen a year earlier.
On a parent basis, its current profits for 1996/97 were 2.41 billion yen, up from 1.83 billion yen in the previous year.
